topic: What to put in a project brief so dev teams can quote it properly
caption:
"Can you quote me for an app?" A good brief turns that into a real answer. 📝

What to put in yours:

1️⃣ The problem and who it's for
2️⃣ The one core user journey
3️⃣ Must-haves vs nice-to-haves
4️⃣ Integrations and existing systems
5️⃣ Timeline, budget range and who maintains it

One page is enough. You'll get clearer quotes and better questions back. Swipe for the details. →

Writing a brief now? DM us BRIEF and we'll tell you what's missing.

Save this for before you contact any dev team. 🔖
